Answer to your question: **v2.31.0 does have the fix** (commit `e3b3d4f` from PR #1122 is an ancestor of the v2.31.0 tag), but what you saw is a **new, different malformed shape**.

## What's happening

The stored block for the message you saw (`019ffb74-5090…`, workspace `menu-clicking`) is:

```
<group<group:Researching>:Researching>\n
```

That's two interleaved copies of the open tag: prefix `<group` + a full well-formed tag + suffix `:Researching>`. The parser correctly matches the inner well-formed tag (so a "Researching" group does form), but the `<group` prefix and `:Researching>` suffix fall outside any match and render as literal text.

**Provenance is settled**: I traced the exact string back to the provider's raw session transcript on disk (`~/.augment/sessions/abe11a8c….json`) — the model (fable-5) emitted it verbatim. intentd stored it faithfully; this is not a daemon delta-accumulation bug. It's the model glitching mid-tag and restarting the tag inside itself. Only 1 genuine instance exists in the whole DB so far.

## Plan

One task added to the spec:

- Add a regex alternative that consumes the full doubled form `<group<group:Name>:Name>` as a single group OPEN, fix capture-group index handling, update both strip regexes, check streaming partial-tag withholding covers the doubled prefix, regression tests first (pinned to the exact DB string), file a new monorepo issue (dedup search found nothing existing) and reference it with `Fixes intent-hq/monorepo#N` in the PR.

Please review and approve the plan above.
